bullets.text: Added Kafka event streaming between billing and shipping, retiring 4 nightly batch jobs.
Moved 9 services to Kubernetes on AWS with Terraform, cutting deploy time from 30 to 8 minutes.
Built Go services on PostgreSQL handling 3M API requests a day at p95 under 80 ms.
Mentored 3 junior developers and ran the weekly on-call review.
Wrote Python and Airflow pipelines loading 40 GB a day into Snowflake.
Tuned SQL reports, cutting the slowest from 6 minutes to 40 seconds.
Built React and TypeScript dashboards used by 120 analysts.
